links.comparator_used: Original question submitted without simplification prompt (default prompt, same models, same 12 questions)
links.outcome: Readability, understandability, actionability, completeness and DISCERN treatment-information quality of Turkish LLM responses (ChatGPT, Gemini, Claude)
links.effect: Understandability improved [F(1,11) = 55.633, P < 0.001, partial η²=0.835]; readability increased for all models; actionability remained 60%; completeness decreased for ChatGPT (P = 0.004) and Claude (P = 0.016) but not Gemini; total DISCERN decreased by 11.58 points for ChatGPT and 11.00 for Claude (both P < 0.001), Gemini's 4.00-point decrease not significant (P = 0.062); accuracy and safety maximal in all groups
links.tradeoff: Simplification reduced completeness and treatment-information quality (DISCERN) for ChatGPT and Claude; professional review and individualization still needed
links.quote: Simplification improved readability and understandability but could reduce completeness and treatment-information quality.
